blocks.title: 1. The Core Concept: Speed-Drilling Dot Products
blocks.content: The Dot Products Gym throws rapid-fire vector multiplication problems at you. You'll practice computing dot products of 2D and 3D vectors under time pressure. The goal is to make the multiply-and-add process so automatic that you don't even think about it.

blocks.title: 2. The Rules: Quick Component Multiply
blocks.content:
• For 2D vectors (a, b) and (c, d): dot product = ac + bd.
• For 3D vectors (a, b, c) and (d, e, f): dot product = ad + be + cf.
• Always multiply matching components, then add all products together.
• Be extra careful with negative signs during multiplication!

blocks.title: 3. The Method: Speed Tips
blocks.content:
To calculate dot products fast:

1. Write the components vertically aligned.
2. Multiply each pair mentally.
3. Keep a running total as you go.
4. Double-check signs: negative times negative = positive, negative times positive = negative.

blocks.title: 5. Common Pitfalls
blocks.content: In 3D dot products, the most common error is forgetting the third component! Students calculate the first two products and write the answer, completely ignoring the z-components. Always count your components: if the vectors are 3D, you need exactly 3 multiplications before adding.
